analysis.title: SanDisk Corp. (SNDK): First Take: Solid quarter, with guidance above the Street
key_insights: GS expects SNDK to be range bound after the 3Q26 print. Revenue and EPS guidance for 4Q were above the Street. Expectations were balanced going in because of strong memory peer prints and strong intra-quarter management commentary, set against somewhat tepid prior guidance and a roughly 20% stock pullback over the last 30 days.

3Q26 revenue was $11.03 bn, in line with GS at $11.22 bn and above the Street (Visible Alpha) at $10.74 bn. Gross margin was 85.1% vs GS 85.7% and Street 84.9%. Non-GAAP EPS was $49.51 vs GS $49.80 and Street $46.73.

4Q26 guidance midpoint for revenue is $12.4 bn (range $12.2-12.6 bn), below GS at $13.55 bn but above the Street at $12.08 bn. Gross margin guide is 85.0% vs GS 85.6% and Street 84.7%. Non-GAAP EPS guide is $55.00-$57.00 (midpoint $56.00), below GS at $59.71 and above the Street at $52.94.
Revenue grew 23.0% QoQ and 377.9% YoY in 3Q26. The 4Q guide implies 12.4% QoQ and 309.9% YoY growth at the midpoint.

GS lists four items for the conference call: details on newly signed LTAs and the share of planned FY27 and FY28 bit volumes they cover, the NAND supply/demand outlook and pricing, any update on capital return plans, and TAM sizing for long-term opportunities in HBF.
GS expects a relatively neutral read-through for MU (Neutral) because of similar end-market exposures.
GS keeps its Buy rating and $2,200 12-month price target, based on 20X P/E applied to normalized EPS of $110. The stock was $1,404.77, implying 56.6% upside. Market cap is $209.3bn.

market_movers.rationale: Target uses a 20X P/E on normalized EPS of $110. The quarter was solid and 4Q guidance beat the Street on revenue and EPS.
GS expects a relatively neutral reaction for MU given similar end-market exposures to SNDK. Disclosures list MU at $983.23.

earnings_insights: SNDK 3Q26 reported (10/29 First Take): revenue $11.03 bn vs GS est $11.22 bn and Street (Visible Alpha) est $10.74 bn. Gross margin 85.1% vs GS est 85.7% and Street est 84.9%. Operating margin 80.4% vs GS est 80.9% and Street est 79.1%. Non-GAAP EPS $49.51 reported vs GS est $49.80 and Street est $46.73.

SNDK 4Q26 guidance (company, given 10/29): revenue $12.2-12.6 bn (midpoint $12.4 bn) vs GS est $13.55 bn and Street est $12.08 bn. Gross margin 84.5%-85.5% (midpoint 85.0%) vs GS est 85.6% and Street est 84.7%. Non-GAAP EPS $55.00-$57.00 (midpoint $56.00) vs GS est $59.71 and Street est $52.94.

GS estimates: FY6/27E revenue $53,154 mn and EPS $231.84, FY6/28E revenue $71,041 mn and EPS $284.98, FY6/29E revenue $78,472 mn and EPS $300.44. Quarterly EPS estimates are $49.80 for 9/26E, $59.71 for 12/26E and $59.05 for 3/27E.
risk_factors: Long-term structural change in NAND pricing fails to materialize.
YMTC continues to iterate on its roadmap.
SanDisk fails to gain eSSD traction.
vol_and_positioning: SNDK fell about 20% over the 30 days before the print, which GS cites as part of the balanced setup into earnings.
